prompt: Use write exactly once create index.html. tiny offline Focus Timer, circular 25-min countdown, Start/Pause Reset, completed-session localStorage. HARD LIMIT 90 nonblank lines, 1200 words. no dependencies. Do not call write_file. reply DONE.

measurement.nonblank_lines: Count index.html lines whose Unicode-trimmed content is non-empty.
measurement.words: Count index.html tokens separated by Unicode whitespace.
measurement.dependency_check: Reject external script, stylesheet, font, media, module, import, or package references.
measurement.network_check: Load in an isolated browser context with network denied and reject any attempted request.
measurement.functional_check_environment: Use a fresh localStorage namespace, load index.html locally, and exercise visible controls with a controllable clock.

functional_checks.description: The page visibly presents the countdown as a circular timer.
A new or reset timer displays and represents exactly 25 minutes.
One control starts an elapsed-time-based countdown and can pause it without losing the remaining time.
Reset stops the timer and restores the full 25-minute duration.
Natural completion increments a completed-session count stored in localStorage and restored after reload.
